title: Cannes Film Festival
metaDescription: Cannes Film Festival 2027 is scheduled for 11–22 May at the Palais des Festivals in Cannes, France.

overview.about: The Cannes Film Festival is the most prestigious event in world cinema, held each May on the French Riviera. Its top prize, the Palme d'Or, can define a director's career, and the red carpet at the Palais des Festivals is the film world's most famous. Cannes is invitation-only and fiercely selective.
overview.nextEvent: The next Cannes Film Festival runs in May in Cannes, on the Cote d'Azur. An international jury awards the Palme d'Or, and the festival's market is also the busiest dealmaking hub in the film industry.
